headline: Good gets better: fundamentals reinforce, growth accelerate

highlights: The ADS business has demonstrated strong growth momentum, supported by a confirmed order backlog of ₹5,870 crore (to be executable in next 5 years), new aerospace customer additions and increasing opportunities aiming to expand wallet share with existing clients.

Its Auto-Tech Agnostic and xEV businesses are witnessing increasing traction, supported by electrification and rising engineered content per vehicle while reporting highest-ever quarterly sales, with combined revenue of ₹136 crore, up by 27% YoY.
This gradual shift towards a more diversified and technology-oriented revenue mix positions Sansera favourably for sustained growth over the medium to long term.

The growth was supported by increasing EV adoption and rising demand for technology-agnostic components. • ADS order book sees another sharp increase : Aerospace, Defence and Semiconductor (ADS) remained a key growth driver, with Q2FY27 revenue of ₹164.3 crore and H1FY27 revenue of ₹309.7 crore.
valuation: Over the longer term, the company is targeting ADS to contribute approximately 35–40% of overall revenue towards the end of the decade, compared with approximately 15% currently (Q2’27).

The company has also been engaging with customers to recover some of the increased commodity-related costs. • FY27 revenue outlook remains encouraging : Management indicated that the business outlook remains positive, with full-year FY27 revenue expected to be in the range of ₹4,250–4,300 crore.
